Sound Shore Management Continues to Hold Stake in Antero Resources (AR); Oracle (ORCL) Holder Hemenway Trust Company Has Decreased Its Stake
June 17, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Hemenway Trust Company Llc decreased its stake in Oracle (ORCL) by 8.29% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hemenway Trust Company Llc sold 10,540 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.15% with the market. The institutional investor held 116,606 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.34M, down from 127,146 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hemenway Trust Company Llc who had been investing in Oracle for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $188.93B market cap company. The stock increased 0.83% or $0.38 during the last trading session, reaching $46.28. About 28.12M shares traded or 80.84% up from the average. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 3.98% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.59% the S&P500. ORCL’s profit will be $3.51 billion for 13.45 P/E if the $0.86 EPS becomes a reality.
